Police seize large quantities of heroin in Punjab, arrest one

Panchkula police arrested one person and seized 256 grams of heroin valued at approximately Rs 50 lakh. The investigation is examining a potential supply link originating from Amritsar. In a separate but related operation, Punjab Police reported busting an alleged cross-border drug network in Amritsar, seizing 10 kilograms of heroin. The exact relationship between the two seizures and the specific details of the alleged cross-border network were not fully elaborated in the coverage.
